events.title: Watch Bearded_Muscle play GRAVHOUNDS!
events.summary: Join Bearded_Muscle for a look at GRAVHOUNDS, our 1–4 player co-op action builder. Download the free demo and wishlist the game!

events.title: Gravhounds - Demo Patch 1
events.summary: We've released a small update focused on stability, with a handful of gameplay and UI fixes. Thanks to everyone sharing feedback and bug reports, they’ve been a huge help. Crash FixesAddressed crashes involving turrets, the multitool, and the compass.Build Kit informationKit details now appear when you look at a Build Kit or hold one. Previously, you had to do both. We also fixed information and markers appearing from too far away.Skitter BehaviorFixed an issue that could leave Skitters jumping

events.title: The Gravhounds Demo is Coming!🎮
events.summary: Hey Gravhounds!After a successful Open Playtest where 20k+ testers deployed to alien planets (and survived the hordes), we’re thrilled to announce that the Gravhounds Demo is coming October 12th, 2026! The demo will allow you to visit 2 Solar Systems with 7 planets, and you’ll be able to choose between four different Gravhounds, Selene, Zane, Dozer and Finn! events.title: Dev Log #1 - Playtest to Demo Changes 📝
events.summary: Since the playtest, we’ve been poring over your feedback and bug reports, watching videos of your playthroughs, and working through improvements for our upcoming demo. Your reports have been invaluable in tracking down problems, and seeing how you play has helped us understand where things feel confusing, frustrating, or need more work. events.title: Open Playtest: Live Now! 📢
events.summary: Rise & Shine Gravhounds! 🔫🐶 We've just brought our Open Playtest online and this time EVERYONE gets to deploy and play to their hearts content. And speaking of content, you are free to stream, capture, edit share and post about this Playtest in any way you want! We'd love to see what you're up to though so don't forget to tag us on X, Instagram or TikTok. if you're having a blast. events.title: Playtests Are Underway 🐶
events.summary: We’ve started inviting players into the GRAVHOUNDS Playtest in limited waves, and we’ll continue expanding the player pool over successive playtests.If you’ve already requested access through Steam, you’re in the pool. We haven’t opened the floodgates yet, but more invites will be going out over time. events.title: Hello, world!
events.summary: Well, this feels surreal.We’ve spent the last three years jamming on this thing together, mostly in secret, and today we finally get to show you what we’ve been making.We’re a small team of seven, based in Seattle and Stockholm.
